name: relu_mask_decomposition
stmt:
lemma relu_mask_decomposition (x : ℝ) :
    relu x = (if 0 < x then 1 else 0) * x
proof:
by
  unfold relu
  by_cases h : 0 < x
  ·                     
    have hmax : max x 0 = x := max_eq_left (le_of_lt h)
    rw [if_pos h, hmax]
    ring
  ·                     
    have hle : x ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt h
    have hmax : max x 0 = 0 := max_eq_right hle
    rw [if_neg h, hmax]
    ring

name: MaskVec
stmt: noncomputable def MaskVec (h : ι → ℝ) : ι → ℝ
proof: fun i => if 0 < h i then 1 else 0

name: ReLUVec
stmt: noncomputable def ReLUVec (h : ι → ℝ) : ι → ℝ

name: relu_vec_mask
stmt:
theorem relu_vec_mask (h : ι → ℝ) :
    ∀ i, ReLUVec h i = MaskVec h i * h i
proof:
by
  intro i
  unfold ReLUVec MaskVec
  exact relu_mask_decomposition (h i)

name: FFNOut
stmt: noncomputable def FFNOut {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (W : ι → ℝ) (h : ι → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ∑ i, W i * ReLUVec h i

name: FFN_effective_linear
stmt:
theorem FFN_effective_linear {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (W h : ι → ℝ) :
    FFNOut W h = ∑ i, (W i * MaskVec h i) * h i
proof:
by
  unfold FFNOut
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [relu_vec_mask h i]
  ring

name: FFN_linear_on_fixed_mask
stmt:
theorem FFN_linear_on_fixed_mask {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (W h h' : ι → ℝ)
    (hmask : ∀ i, MaskVec h i = MaskVec h' i) :
    FFNOut W h - FFNOut W h' = ∑ i, (W i * MaskVec h i) * (h i - h' i)
proof:
by
  rw [FFN_effective_linear W h, FFN_effective_linear W h']
        
  calc
    (∑ i, (W i * MaskVec h i) * h i) - (∑ i, (W i * MaskVec h' i) * h' i)
        = (∑ i, (W i * MaskVec h i) * h i) - (∑ i, (W i * MaskVec h i) * h' i) := by
                                 
          apply congrArg (fun x => _ - x)
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i hi
          rw [hmask i]
    _ = ∑ i, (W i * MaskVec h i) * (h i - h' i) := by
             
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      ring

name: relu_zero_iff_mask_zero
stmt: theorem relu_zero_iff_mask_zero (x : ℝ) : relu x = 0 ↔ (if 0 < x then 1 else 0) = 0
proof:
by
  rw [relu_eq_zero_iff]
                                         
  by_cases h : 0 < x
  ·                              
    rw [if_pos h]
    constructor
    · intro hxle; linarith
    · intro h1; norm_num at h1
  ·                         
    rw [if_neg h]
    constructor
    · intro _; rfl
    · intro _; exact le_of_not_gt h

end Lattice
